condition: Banks a party may deal with
state: All but 13 entities named in Resolution No. (4) of 1445 AH: local and foreign financial and non-financial institutions and individuals are prohibited from dealing with them; violators face accountability and legal penalties
note: Resolution in force from its issuance, 31 May 2024 (Article 3). Entities named: Al Qutaibi Islamic Bank for Microfinance; Al-Busairi Microfinance Bank; Aden Islamic Bank for Microfinance; First Aden Islamic Bank; National Bank of Yemen - Aden; The Cooperative and Agricultural Credit Bank - Aden; Al Shumul Islamic Microfinance Bank; Al Salam Capital Islamic Microfinance Bank; Tamkeen Microfinance Bank; Alinma Bank for Microfinance; Sharq Yemeni Bank For Islamic Microfinance; Hadhramout Commercial Bank; Bin Dowal Islamic Microfinance Bank.

condition: Licence needed to conduct banking business
state: A licence from the Central Bank of Yemen headquartered in Sana'a: conducting banking business without one violates the laws in force and the bank's instructions
note: Stated in the recital of Resolution No. (4) of 1445 AH as the ground for its prohibition.

condition: E-wallets available
state: 16 wallets listed under 'Electronic payment services companies', wallet (provider): ام فلوس (بنك الكريمي للتمويل الأصغر); محفظتي (بنك التضامن); بيس (بنك الأمل للتمويل الأصغر); موبايل موني (كاك بنك); فلوسك (بنك اليمن والكويت بالشراكة مع شركة كواليتي كونكت); الدولي موني (بنك اليمن الدولي); الشامل موني (مصرف اليمن البحرين الشامل); كاش (الشركة المالية تمكين); ون كاش (شركة المحفظة الوطنية الإلكترونية); جوالي (شركة وي كاش); سبأ كاش (كاك الإسلامي بالشراكة مع شركة سبأفون للاتصالات); جيب (شركة عهد للخدمات المالية); التجاري كاش (البنك التجاري اليمني); ايزي (شركة ثروات للخدمات المالية والاستثمار); WaaS (بنك اليمن والكويت); M-Pay (الشركة اليمنية المتكاملة للخدمات المالية والإلكترونية)
note: The bank's own list page; it names the bank only as Central Bank of Yemen. The table also gives each provider's city, address and contacts.

condition: Acceptance of the 200-riyal denomination
state: Acceptable: the Central Bank of Yemen confirms that the Yemeni legal currency denomination of 200 riyals is acceptable
note: Undated headline in the page's 'Most read' list, not presented as the page's current rule.

condition: Circulation of a 50-rial coin
state: Issued for circulation, by announcement of the Central Bank of Yemen
note: Undated headline in the page's 'Most read' list, not presented as the page's current rule.

condition: Transfer of oil products, weapons and dual-use equipment that funds the Houthis
state: Targeted by U.S. sanctions issued on 16 January 2026: 21 individuals and entities and one vessel, including alleged front companies in Yemen, Oman and the United Arab Emirates
note: CNBC report of an OFAC statement; it does not say what the sanctions prohibit or for whom.

condition: Cybercrime law
state: A bill on cybercrime awaiting legislative approval
note: UNCTAD news item on its Cyberlaw Tracker, published 24 February 2022 (page date element); the page says nothing else about Yemen.

condition: Services for sending money from Saudi Arabia to Yemen
state: Money transfer operators priced in the corridor: MoneyGram, STC Pay, Fawri, Western Union
note: World Bank Remittance Prices Worldwide corridor page; data collected 21 August to 2 September 2025. The table lists 8 products from these 4 firms.

condition: Cost of sending money from Saudi Arabia to Yemen
state: Total average 2.70 (total cost, per cent) for sending 750.00 SAR, Third Quarter 2025
note: The 2.70 is the page's total average for the quarter; the page defines total cost as the fee charged to the sender plus the exchange rate margin.

condition: International card brands issued to cardholders in Yemen
state: MasterCard, provided by SabaCard through a partnership with the Yemeni Commercial Bank; Visa card service offered by SabaCard
note: SabaCard (Yemen Payments and Cards Co.) describing its own services.

condition: Card acceptance by merchants
state: SabaCard provides acquiring of local and international cards (Visa and MasterCard) and POS switching and networks
note: SabaCard describing its own services.

condition: Electronic bill payment and mobile top-up services
state: SabaCard provides electronic bill payments and mobile e-voucher and top-up refill
note: SabaCard describing its own services.

condition: Card switching and processing services for banks
state: SabaCard provides local, national and international switching and ATM and POS networking to local banks, which may be its shareholders and users of its services or just users
note: SabaCard describing its own services; Yemen Commercial Bank is its main shareholder.

condition: Use of assets of designated individuals and entities in Yemen
state: Frozen: the assets freeze on certain designated individuals and entities in Yemen, first imposed by resolution 2140 (2014), renewed by resolution 2801 (2025) until 14 November 2026
note: UN press release of 14 November 2025; the renewal runs for 12 months, to 14 November 2026. A travel ban was renewed with it.

condition: Banks a party may deal with
state: Not Yemen Kuwait Bank for Trade and Investment, sanctioned by OFAC: its property in the United States or held by U.S. persons is blocked; transactions by U.S. persons or within (or transiting) the United States involving designated persons' property are generally prohibited unless licensed by OFAC or exempt; violations may bring civil or criminal penalties on U.S. and foreign persons; financial institutions and other persons may risk exposure to sanctions for certain transactions with designated persons
note: U.S. Treasury press release of 17 January 2025, as republished by GlobalSecurity.org. Yemen-based bank designated under E.O. 13224.

condition: U.S. correspondent accounts of foreign financial institutions
state: OFAC can prohibit or impose strict conditions on the opening or maintaining in the United States of a correspondent or payable-through account of a foreign financial institution that knowingly conducted or facilitated a significant transaction on behalf of a Specially Designated Global Terrorist; transactions with the individuals designated on 17 January 2025 entail risk of these secondary sanctions
note: U.S. Treasury press release of 17 January 2025, as republished by GlobalSecurity.org.

condition: International card brands issued to cardholders in Yemen
state: UnionPay card, to be issued in Yemen by the Cooperative and Agriculture Credit Bank of Yemen (CAC) under an agreement signed with UnionPay International
note: Electronic Payments International news item of 29 December 2014.

condition: Card acceptance by merchants
state: UnionPay cards: the agreement with CAC enables local merchants to accept them and will raise UnionPay card acceptance coverage to about 50% of the Yemeni market, through CAC's ATMs and merchants
note: Electronic Payments International news item of 29 December 2014; the coverage figure is stated as an expected effect (will facilitate).

condition: Currency for domestic sales, services and financial contracts
state: National currency only: foreign currencies may not be used in its place in any commercial or service transaction or financial contract (القرار رقم (13) لسنة 2025); foreign currency is banned where a transaction does not require it, such as school and medical fees, rents and travel tickets; violators face legal accountability
note: Council of Ministers (مجلس الوزراء) decision approved at its latest meeting, as reported on 12 August 2025. The same report names a second area for the rial obligation: see YQ-A020.

condition: Currency for domestic sales, services and financial contracts
state: Yemeni rial only (حصراً) for buying and selling goods and services and for financial contracts of all kinds, except cases that require payment in foreign currency abroad; ministers of industry and trade, justice and interior and the governors of the liberated governorates to enforce it
place: All liberated areas and governorates (جميع المناطق والمحافظات المحررة)
note: Same Council of Ministers decision as YQ-A019, as reported on 12 August 2025.

condition: Banks a party may deal with
state: All but 6 banks: by decision of the governor of the Central Bank of Yemen, all banks, exchange companies and establishments and remittance agents are to stop dealing with التضامن، اليمن الكويت، اليمن والبحرين الشامل، الأمل للتمويل الأصغر، الكريمي للتمويل الأصغر الإسلامي and اليمن الدولي, for implementing Houthi militia directives
note: Al Arabiya, 30 May 2024; the page is tagged المركزي اليمني - عدن. The decision is addressed to banks, exchange firms and remittance agents in the Republic.

condition: Service to the public by banks the central bank has stopped dealing with
state: Must continue providing banking services to the public and meeting obligations to customers until further notice
note: Al Arabiya, 30 May 2024; the page is tagged المركزي اليمني - عدن.

condition: Where banks must base their operations centres
state: The temporary capital Aden (العاصمة المؤقتة عدن): banks in Sana'a were given 60 days, two months earlier, to move their operations centres there, and the deadline had ended
note: Al Arabiya, 30 May 2024; the page is tagged المركزي اليمني - عدن.

condition: Banks' dealing with a group designated as terrorist
state: Grounds for sanction: the banks sanctioned kept dealing with a group classified as terrorist (جماعة مصنفة إرهابياً) and implementing its instructions, in violation of banking rules, the law and the central bank's instructions, and did not comply with anti-money-laundering and counter-terrorist-financing requirements
note: Al Arabiya, 30 May 2024; the page is tagged المركزي اليمني - عدن.

condition: Banks' dealing in the national currency
state: Prevented by the Houthi group: the decision followed its 'منع البنوك من إجراءات التعامل بالعملة الوطنية'
note: Al Arabiya, 30 May 2024; the page is tagged المركزي اليمني - عدن. The phrase is quoted in the report of the decision's background.

condition: Circulation of a 100-rial coin
state: A 100-rial coin minted by the Houthi militia; the group also issued currencies (إصدار عملات)
note: Al Arabiya, 30 May 2024; the page is tagged المركزي اليمني - عدن.

condition: Circulation of a 100-rial coin
state: Illegal (غير قانونية): the central bank considers its minting a serious violation against the national economy
note: Al Arabiya, 30 May 2024; the page is tagged المركزي اليمني - عدن.

condition: Use of pre-2016 edition banknotes
state: To be deposited: the central bank called on all individuals, shops, companies, other bodies and financial institutions to deposit old-edition banknotes from before 2016 within at most 60 days
note: Al Arabiya, 30 May 2024; the page is tagged المركزي اليمني - عدن.

condition: Domestic transfer network exchange companies may or must use
state: UNMONEY (الشبكة الموحدة للأموال) obligatory: a circular of the Central Bank of Yemen in Aden obliges exchange companies and establishments to use it
place: Areas under government control (المناطق الخاضعة لسيطرة الحكومة)
note: Al-Masdar Online, 8 July 2024. Launched by circular in mid-February 2024.

condition: Domestic transfer network exchange companies may or must use
state: UNMONEY only: exchange companies that had not joined it were suspended and their branches closed; all exchange companies and establishments and remittance agents directed to make all new domestic transfers in cash exclusively through it (بشكل نقدي حصراً عبر هذه الشبكة)
note: Al-Masdar Online, 8 July 2024. Decisions of the internationally recognised government through the central bank in Aden.

condition: Domestic transfer network exchange companies may or must use
state: Local transfer networks owned by banks or exchange companies stopped totally and finally; pending operations to be settled within 15 days of the decision, then a move to the unified network
note: Al-Masdar Online, 8 July 2024. Decision of the central bank in Aden of Wednesday 26 June 2024, covering networks operating in the Republic (العاملة في الجمهورية).

condition: Domestic transfer network exchange companies may or must use
state: UNMONEY barred: exchange companies and establishments and local money transfer networks prohibited from dealing with it (circular of March 2024)
place: Yemeni Exchangers Association in Sana'a's area (جمعية الصرافين اليمنيين في صنعاء)
note: Al-Masdar Online, 8 July 2024. The source places the association in Sana'a, under Houthi control.

condition: Banks a party may deal with
state: Only banks licensed by the Central Bank of Yemen in Sana'a: exchange companies and establishments and local money transfer networks prohibited from dealing with banks it has not licensed (circular of March 2024)
place: Yemeni Exchangers Association in Sana'a's area (جمعية الصرافين اليمنيين في صنعاء)
note: Al-Masdar Online, 8 July 2024. The source places the association in Sana'a, under Houthi control.

condition: Domestic transfer network exchange companies may or must use
state: Barred: the Exchangers Association and the central bank in Sana'a prevent exchange companies from joining the money transfer network (شبكة التحويلات المالية) and close any company that deals with this network
note: Al-Masdar Online, 8 July 2024. Stated as the premise of a hypothetical (على افتراض استمرار منع).

condition: Central bank monitoring of transfers through exchange companies
state: An electronic system that all money transfer networks have joined: the bank can see any person's transfers by the sender's and recipient's mobile numbers and names, and a general number has unified transfer numbers in Yemen
note: Al-Masdar Online, 8 July 2024. The source calls the bank البنك المركزي الخاضع للحوثيين في صنعاء.

condition: Central bank monitoring of transfers through exchange companies
state: Disabled (معطّلة): the central bank in Aden's oversight of exchange companies
place: In Aden or in other areas (سواء في عدن أو في المناطق الأخرى)
note: Al-Masdar Online, 8 July 2024. Past tense in the source (كانت), set against the network's launch; no date given.

condition: Depositors' withdrawal of bank deposits
state: Lost: since the central bank moved its headquarters to Aden in 2016, depositors have lost the right to withdraw or dispose of their money
note: Al-Masdar Online, 8 July 2024. Since 2016.

condition: Where depositors keep their money
state: With exchange shops (محلات الصرافة), or converted into gold
note: Al-Masdar Online, 8 July 2024.

condition: Exchange companies operating
state: Estimated in the thousands (يُقدر عددها بالآلاف); exchange companies became safer than banks (أكثر أمانًا من البنوك)
note: Al-Masdar Online, 8 July 2024.

condition: Use of foreign currency injected through central bank auctions
state: Restricted, through the unified network, to imports of goods through the port of Aden
note: Al-Masdar Online, 8 July 2024. Given among the reasons the government and the central bank in Aden keep transfers to one channel.

condition: Authority that collects customs on imports
state: The Houthi militia: billions of riyals in customs on imports to Sana'a through Hodeidah port
note: Al-Masdar Online, 8 July 2024.

condition: Banks' payment of salaries for organisations and companies they serve
state: Undeclared inability (عجزًا غير معلنا) to pay them
place: Areas under Houthi militia control (مناطق سيطرة ميليشيا الحوثي)
note: Al-Masdar Online, 8 July 2024.

condition: Banks a party may deal with
state: All but 13 banks in government areas, banned (حظر) by the central bank in Sana'a, among them the state-owned National Bank and Agricultural Credit Bank, for practising banking without a licence
note: Al-Masdar Online, 31 May 2024. The source calls the bank البنك المركزي التابع لسلطات الحوثيين في صنعاء (غير معترف به), issuing on Friday. Banks listed, each in its own paragraph: بنك القطيبي الإسلامي للتمويل الأصغر؛ بنك البسيري للتمويل الأصغر؛ بنك عدن الإسلامي للتمويل الأصغر؛ بنك عدن الأول الإسلامي؛ البنك الأهلي اليمني - عدن؛ بنك التسليف التعاوني الزراعي - عدن؛ بنك الشمول للتمويل الأصغر الإسلامي؛ بنك السلام كابيتال للتمويل الأصغر الإسلامي؛ بنك تمكين للتمويل الأصغر؛ بنك الإنماء للتمويل الأصغر؛ بنك الشرق اليمني للتمويل الأصغر الإسلامي؛ بنك حضرموت التجاري؛ بنك بن دول للتمويل الأصغر الإسلامي.

condition: Licence needed to conduct banking business
state: A licence from the central bank in Sana'a: practising banking without one violates the laws in force and the bank's instructions, as its statement says
note: Al-Masdar Online, 31 May 2024.

condition: Banks a party may deal with
state: All but 6 banks: decision of the Central Bank of Yemen in Aden to stop dealing with بنك التضامن، بنك اليمن والكويت، مصرف اليمن والبحرين الشامل، بنك الأمل للتمويل الأصغر، بنك الكريمي للتمويل الأصغر and بنك اليمن الدولي, implemented from 2 June
note: Al-Masdar Online, 31 May 2024. Decision issued on Thursday and implemented from 2 June (ينفذ ابتداء من الثاني من يونيو).

condition: Service to the public by banks the central bank has stopped dealing with
state: Must continue providing banking services to the public and meeting obligations to customers until further notice
note: Al-Masdar Online, 31 May 2024. Part of the decision implemented from 2 June.

condition: Where banks must base their operations centres
state: Aden: the central bank in Aden directed banks to move their operations headquarters to Aden, in directives issued in early April; six banks in Sana'a failed to
note: Al-Masdar Online, 31 May 2024. Directives issued early last April (مطلع أبريل الماضي).

condition: E-wallets available
state: ون كاش, an electronic money service in place of paper money, on Yemen Kuwait Bank's page, which also presents فلوسك and كاش under 'لكل هدف مالي، لدينا الحل المناسب'
note: Yemen Kuwait Bank's page for ون كاش, describing its own service. The فلوسك and كاش tiles link to pages under yk-bank.com/ar/Personal/e-wallet/.

condition: Payments an e-wallet can make
state: All financial transactions, such as money transfers, paying for purchases and paying bills (ون كاش)
note: Yemen Kuwait Bank's page for ون كاش, describing its own service.

condition: Requirements to open an e-wallet
state: Go to the nearest service agent, show proof of identity, fill in the service request form and give a phone number on any local network; documents: a valid personal ID card (for non-Yemenis a valid passport with valid residence) and the request form (ون كاش)
note: Yemen Kuwait Bank's page for ون كاش, describing its own service.

condition: Law on payment systems and electronic financial and banking operations
state: Law No. (40) of 2006 on payment systems and electronic financial and banking operations, one of the laws Resolution No. (4) of 1445 AH was issued after perusal of
note: Saba text of the Sana'a resolution of 31 May 2024.

condition: Law on payment systems and electronic financial and banking operations
state: Laws on payment systems and electronic banking (قوانين أنظمة الدفع والمصرفية الإلكترونية), among the Yemeni laws the central bank in Sana'a's decision rests on, as its statement says
note: Al-Masdar Online, 31 May 2024; no law number given.

condition: Foreign currency supply through central bank auctions
state: Billions of dollars injected into the market in auctions by the Aden government through the central bank, to improve the rial's exchange rate in its areas; the money goes to importing goods for companies mostly headquartered in Sana'a
note: Al-Masdar Online, 8 July 2024; the source says the auctions failed to improve the rate (لكن دون جدوى).

condition: Exchange houses a party may deal with
state: Sanctioned by the U.S. Treasury: Swaid and Sons for Exchange Co., a Houthi-associated money exchange; earlier Treasury sanctions targeted Houthi-affiliated exchange houses
note: U.S. Treasury press release of 17 January 2025, as republished by GlobalSecurity.org; it does not date the earlier sanctions.

condition: Which banks institutions and individuals may deal with
state: All except 13 named banks (يحضر على المؤسسات المالية وغير المالية المحلية والخارجية والأفراد التعامل مع 13 بنكاً), among them Aden-based banks

condition: Which banks institutions and individuals may deal with
state: Dealing stopped with a number of banks (قرار وقف التعامل مع عدد من البنوك والمصارف)

condition: Which printed rial banknotes may be dealt in
state: Notes printed before 2016 cancelled (إلغاء التعامل بالعملة النقدية المطبوعة قبل العام 2016م)

condition: What holders of rial banknotes withdrawn from dealing must do
state: Hand them in to the Aden bank within sixty days (توريد العملة القديمة ما قبل 2016م إلى بنك عدن خلال ستين يوما)
note: Applies to citizens, companies and banking institutions (المواطنين ، والشركات والمؤسسات المصرفية).

condition: Rate at which rials buy and sell one US dollar
state: Above 1768 buying and 1776 selling (تجاوز 1768 للشراء و 1776 ريال للدولار الواحد للبيع)
place: Aden and the occupied governorates (عدن والمحافظات المحتلة)

condition: Rate at which rials buy and sell one US dollar
state: 466 buying and 467 selling (عند 466 للشراء و 467 ريال مقابل الدولار الواحد للبيع)

condition: Which banks and exchange firms exchange companies and money-transfer networks may deal with
state: All except Al-Kuraimi Islamic Microfinance Bank (إيقاف التعامل مع “بنك الكريمي للتمويل الأصغر الإسلامي” بناءً على تعليمات البنك المركزي)
note: Circular of the Yemeni Exchangers Association in Sana'a, on the central bank's instructions, issued on the day of publication (اليوم الأحد).

condition: What exchange firms and money-transfer networks must do with balances at a bank they are barred from dealing with
state: Liquidate them within 15 days, by 6 July 2025, and report the balances to the central bank in Sana'a (تصفية أرصدتها لدى البنك خلال فترة 15 يوماً)

condition: Which banks and exchange firms exchange companies and money-transfer networks may deal with
state: All except two exchange firms, Ahmed Al-Haddad Express Exchange and Ahmed Al-Haddad Exchange (إيقاف التعامل مع منشأتي)
place: Yemeni Exchangers Association in Sana'a's area (جمعية الصرافين اليمنيين في صنعاء)
note: The association's earlier circular (الجمعة الفائتة); reason given: breach of the central bank's instructions.

condition: What heavy-transport drivers pay to move goods within a governorate
state: Levies at multiple collection points, with improvement fees collected repeatedly (تعدد نقاط الجبايات وتكرار تحصيل رسوم التحسين داخل المحافظة)
note: From the site-wide news ticker (lines 1-41), identical on all 23 yemeneco.org pages in this run; recorded once, here.

condition: Which banks financial institutions may deal with
state: All except Al-Kuraimi Islamic Finance Bank, from 26 June 2025 (إيقاف التعامل مع بنك الكريمي للتمويل الإسلامي بدءًا من تاريخ 26 ذو الحجة 1446هـ، الموافق 26 يونيو 2025م)
place: areas controlled by the Houthi group (مناطق سيطرة جماعة الحوثي)
note: Circular of the central bank in Sana'a, addressed to all financial institutions operating in the Republic of Yemen and sent to banks and financial companies operating in areas controlled by the Houthi group.

condition: What financial institutions must do with balances at a bank they are barred from dealing with
state: Liquidate them and close all dealings within 15 days of the decision taking effect (تصفية أرصدتها مع بنك الكريمي خلال فترة لا تتجاوز 15 يومًا من تاريخ سريان القرار)
place: areas controlled by the Houthi group (مناطق سيطرة جماعة الحوثي)
note: held_at is the source's 26 June 2025 plus its 15 days.

condition: Which identity documents a customer must show to carry out a financial transaction or money transfer
state: Unexpired national-number ID card, passport, family card, social security card or driving licence for a natural person; commercial register for a company or establishment; expired documents and survey forms refused (عدم قبول أي وثيقة هوية منتهية الصلاحية (تاريخ سريانها منتهٍ)، أو استمارات الاستبيان)
note: Central bank circular 17 of 1447, to all financial institutions and exchange companies operating in the Republic of Yemen, in force from the day of publication (اعتباراً من تاريخ اليوم).

condition: Which personal ID cards are accepted as a legal document in transactions
state: Only cards under ten years from issue; older cards void (جميع البطائق الشخصية التي تجاوزت مدة عشر سنوات من تاريخ إصدارها أصبحت لاغية)
place: Civil Status and Civil Registry Authority in Sana'a's area (مصلحة الأحوال المدنية والسجل المدني في صنعاء)

condition: Which identity documents a customer must show to carry out a financial transaction or money transfer
state: Expired personal ID cards accepted for a further three months (تمديد فترة التعامل بالبطائق الشخصية منتهية الصلاحية لمدة ثلاثة أشهر)
note: Circular 18 of 1447 to all financial institutions; the source gives the period as three months without an end date.

condition: Which identity documents a customer must show to carry out a financial transaction or money transfer
state: Expired personal ID cards accepted for one more month (تمديد فترة التعامل بالبطائق الشخصية المنتهية الصلاحية لدى المؤسسات المالية العاملة في البلاد لمدة شهر إضافي)
note: Circular 40 of 1447, following the December 2025 circular that allowed expired cards temporarily.

condition: In what form a customer may draw balances and transfers held at exchange firms and transfer networks
state: In cash, in the same currency, without restriction (نقداً وبالعملة نفسها) (ويحق للعميل استلامها نقداً بدون أي قيود)
note: Circular of the Yemeni Exchangers Association in Sana'a, on the central bank's directions.

condition: Whether exchange firms and transfer networks may charge a commission for paying out balances or transfers in cash
state: No; a commission for cash payout is a ground for complaint (طلب الشركة أو المنشأة خصم عمولات مقابل التسليم النقدي)

condition: Highest price in rials at which a US dollar may be sold
state: 530.50 rials (أبقى سعر بيع الدولار الأمريكي مقابل الريال اليمني عند 530,50 ريال يمني)
note: The central bank's daily statement of the highest selling prices approved at its foreign-exchange dealings unit, for Tuesday (لليوم الثلاثاء).

condition: Highest price in rials at which a Saudi riyal may be sold
state: 140 rials (سعر بيع الريال السعودي مقابل الريال اليمني عند 140 ريالاً يمنياً)

condition: Price in Saudi riyals at which a US dollar is sold
state: 3.79 Saudi riyals (بـ 3.79 ريال سعودي للدولار)

condition: What holders of rial banknotes withdrawn from dealing must do
state: Individuals other than merchants, banks and exchangers hand in the notes printed by the Aden bank within 30 days from 19 December 2019 at e-wallet agents, compensated in e-money or legal currency up to the approved ceiling (تعويض المواطنين «الأفراد» المغرر بهم من غير «التجار والبنوك والصرافين» بنقد إلكتروني أو بالعملة الوطنية القانونية)
place: Sana'a and the governorates under the Supreme Political Council and the National Salvation Government (صنعاء والمحافظات الواقعة تحت سلطة المجلس السياسي الأعلى وحكومة الإنقاذ الوطني)
note: Sana'a central bank decision; the source gives the period as 30 days from 19 December 2019, with no request considered afterwards.

condition: Which electronic money services are available to pay with
state: Mobile Money, Quality Connect and M-Floos (موبايل موني – كوالتي كونكت – إم فلوس)
place: Sana'a and the governorates under the Supreme Political Council and the National Salvation Government (صنعاء والمحافظات الواقعة تحت سلطة المجلس السياسي الأعلى وحكومة الإنقاذ الوطني)
note: Named as the electronic cash wallets whose agents take in the notes (وكلاء المحافظ النقدية الإلكترونية).

condition: Which printed rial banknotes may be dealt in
state: Not the notes printed by the Aden bank: trading or holding them is not authorized (اعتبار التداول أو الحيازة للعملة غير القانونية إضراراً جسيماً)
place: Sana'a and the governorates under the Supreme Political Council and the National Salvation Government (صنعاء والمحافظات الواقعة تحت سلطة المجلس السياسي الأعلى وحكومة الإنقاذ الوطني)

condition: Which printed rial banknotes may be dealt in
state: Not the new 500-rial note (منع تداول العملة الجديدة من فئة (500))
place: Sana'a and the governorates under the Supreme Political Council and the National Salvation Government (صنعاء والمحافظات الواقعة تحت سلطة المجلس السياسي الأعلى وحكومة الإنقاذ الوطني)
note: Directive of the National Salvation Government.

condition: Which printed rial banknotes may be dealt in
state: Not the new 500-rial note (العملة الجديدة من فئة (500) غير مقبولة للتداول)
place: Sana'a and the governorates under the Supreme Political Council and the National Salvation Government (صنعاء والمحافظات الواقعة تحت سلطة المجلس السياسي الأعلى وحكومة الإنقاذ الوطني)
note: Statement of the then Minister of Finance.

condition: Which printed rial banknotes may be dealt in
state: Not the new 1000-rial note: citizens and financial and banking institutions warned against it (حذرت حكومة الإنقاذ المواطنين والمؤسسات المالية والمصرفية من تداول العملة الجديدة فئة (1000))
place: Sana'a and the governorates under the Supreme Political Council and the National Salvation Government (صنعاء والمحافظات الواقعة تحت سلطة المجلس السياسي الأعلى وحكومة الإنقاذ الوطني)

condition: Which printed rial banknotes banks and exchange firms may accept
state: Not the newly printed notes, by signed undertakings (بعدم قبول تداول العملات الجديدة المطبوعة)
place: Sana'a and the governorates under the Supreme Political Council and the National Salvation Government (صنعاء والمحافظات الواقعة تحت سلطة المجلس السياسي الأعلى وحكومة الإنقاذ الوطني)
note: Meetings since June 2017; the last on 4 June 2018.

condition: Which printed rial banknotes importers, wholesalers, malls and fuel stations may deal in
state: Not the new 500 and 1000 issue (بعدم التعامل بالطبعة الجديدة من فئة (500 – 1000))
place: Sana'a and the governorates under the Supreme Political Council and the National Salvation Government (صنعاء والمحافظات الواقعة تحت سلطة المجلس السياسي الأعلى وحكومة الإنقاذ الوطني)
note: Circular of the Ministry of Industry and Trade to the Chamber of Commerce and Industry.

condition: Which printed rial banknotes may be dealt in
state: Not any denomination of the new notes: not recognized, illegal, and dealing in them criminalized, with field inspections of markets, shops and financial institutions (بوقف التعامل بكل الفئات من تلك الأوراق النقدية وعدم الاعتراف بها واعتبارها غير قانونية وتجريم كل من يتعامل بها)
place: Sana'a and the governorates under the Supreme Political Council and the National Salvation Government (صنعاء والمحافظات الواقعة تحت سلطة المجلس السياسي الأعلى وحكومة الإنقاذ الوطني)
note: Cabinet decision 57 of 2018 of the National Salvation Government.

condition: Which printed rial banknotes banks and exchange firms may accept
state: Earlier denominations only; new issues barred in all dealings of commercial banks, exchange companies and official bodies (شدد على منع تداولها في كافة تعاملات البنوك التجارية وشركات الصرافة والمرافق الرسمية، مقابل الاستمرار بالفئات النقدية السابقة)
note: The Sana'a central bank's response to the Aden bank's 1000-rial note of early February 2018 (line 58).

condition: Which printed rial banknotes may be dealt in
state: Old denominations only; new issues barred, for banks, their clients, exchange companies and official bodies (التشديد على التعامل بالفئات النقدية القديمة ومنع الإصدارات الجديدة)

condition: Which printed rial banknotes may be dealt in
state: The new issue, with the old withdrawn (يجري التعامل بالإصدار الجديد وسحب القديم)

condition: Which printed rial banknotes may be dealt in
state: A new 500-rial note put into circulation in place of the old currency (طرحها للتداول عوضاً عن العملة القديمة السائدة في السوق)

condition: Which printed rial banknotes may be dealt in
state: A new 1000-rial note put into circulation (طرح عملة جديدة فئة الألف ريال)

condition: Rate at which rials buy and sell one US dollar
state: 215 rials (في 2016 م تساوي 215 ريالاً للدولار)

condition: Rate at which rials buy and sell one US dollar
state: 550 rials (انخفض سعر الريال إلى 550 ريالا للدولار الواحد)

condition: Rate at which rials buy and sell one US dollar
state: 250 rials at the official rate (250 ريالاً للدولار الواحد وفق السعر الرسمي)

condition: Rate at which rials buy and sell one US dollar
state: 370 rials (انخفضت إلى 370 ريالاً للدولار)
note: A month and a half after mid-June 2017, as the source puts it.

condition: Rate at which rials buy and sell one US dollar
state: 475 rials (انخفض الريال إلى 475 ريالاً للدولار)
note: After the events of early 2018 that the source describes (lines 58-59).

condition: Whether money exchange may be practised without a current central-bank licence
state: No; practising after the licence has expired, without renewal, is an offence (أي ممارسة لأعمال الصرافة بعد انتهاء الترخيص وبدون تجديد تُعد مخالفة يعاقب عليها القانون)
note: All licences issued to exchangers expired on 31 December 2025 (line 59).

condition: How an exchanger renews a licence to practise money exchange
state: By application through the central bank's e-portal, 15 January to 30 April 2026 (تقديم طلبات تجديد التراخيص عبر البوابة الإلكترونية)

condition: Which banks and exchange firms exchange companies and money-transfer networks may deal with
state: All except seven exchange firms: Cash In Go, Majed Radman, Tilal Sana'a, Al-Qa'afi, Al-Barti, Ard Al-Wisam Express and Al-Rukn Al-Dhahabi (إيقاف التعامل مع سبع منشآت صرافة، بموجب تعليمات البنك المركزي)
note: Circular of the Yemeni Exchangers Association in Sana'a on the central bank's instructions; reason given: breach of the Sana'a central bank's instructions (line 70).

condition: Which banks and exchange firms exchange companies and money-transfer networks may deal with
state: All except five exchange firms: Ibn Bazdan, Al-Muljami, Issam Bazdan, Al-Lahbi and Al-Ammari (بإيقاف التعامل مع منشآت (ابن بزدان- الملجمي- عصام بزدان- اللهبي- العماري) للصرافة)
note: Circular of the Yemeni Exchangers Association, on the central bank's directions.

condition: Whether network and pyramid marketing companies may be dealt with
state: No: QNet and similar entities are unlicensed, and dealing with them exposes those involved to legal accountability (التعامل مع مثل هذه الشركات يعرّض المتورطين للمساءلة القانونية)
note: The bank describes their selling as low-value goods at high prices, with profits for recruiting subscribers and money moved abroad through illegal networks.

condition: Whether network and pyramid marketing companies may be dealt with
state: No: citizens and financial establishments warned against dealing with them (يحذر المواطنين والمنشآت المالية من التعامل مع شركات التسويق الشبكي والهرمي)

condition: How most daily transactions are paid
state: In cash, outside the formal banking sector (يتم تداول معظم المعاملات اليومية خارج القطاع المصرفي الرسمي)
note: The source says it of Yemen as a whole (النظام المالي اليمني).

condition: Share of adults who hold a formal account
state: 12% of adults; women no more than 2% (نسبة امتلاك الحسابات الرسمية 12% فقط من السكان البالغين)
note: The source says it of Yemen as a whole (النظام المالي اليمني).

condition: How many electronic money accounts exist
state: About 800,000, opened since the services began in 2019-2020 (ما يقارب 800,000 حساب أموال إلكترونية)
note: The source says it of Yemen as a whole (اليمن).

condition: Whether money can move instantly between different banks and e-wallets
state: No: banks and e-wallets work in semi-closed systems, with almost no unified payment system between banks (الجزر الرقمية المنعزلة)
note: The source says it of Yemen as a whole (القطاع المالي في اليمن).

condition: Whether electronic money services are provided for by regulation
state: Yes: rules from circular 11 of 2014 to decision 1 of 2020 on e-money services (المنشور رقم (11) لعام 2014 وصولاً إلى القرار رقم (1) لعام 2020 بشأن خدمات النقود الإلكترونية)
note: The source doesn't name the authority that issued them.

condition: How available cash banknotes are
state: Scarce, with damaged notes piling up and no periodic replacement of notes (شحة السيولة النقدية من جهة، وتراكم "النقد التالف")
note: The source says it of Yemen as a whole (الاقتصاد اليمني ككل).

condition: Whether worn banknotes are accepted in payment
state: Worn notes get refused, at a loss to the holder (رفض العملات الورقية المهترئة)

condition: Whether government taxes and fees can be paid electronically
state: Yes, at several government bodies: e.g. Mahfathati (traffic and land-transport fees) and Jaib (zakat, E-Sadad and MPS government fees) (تحصيل الضرائب والجمارك والرسوم الحكومية (P2G) عبر المحافظ)

condition: Which electronic money services are available to pay with
state: Jaib, Jawali, Mahfathati and Mobile Money (the leading four), and Cash ONE (جيب، جوالي، محفظتي، موبايل موني)
note: The source says it of Yemen as a whole (المحافظ الرقمية في اليمن).

condition: Who issues electronic money
state: Banks (Mahfathati of Al-Tadhamon Bank, Mobile Money of CAC Bank) and fintech companies (Cash ONE, Jaib, Jawali), the latter acting indirectly for the central bank as e-money issuers (E-money issuers)

condition: Which electronic money services are available to pay with
state: The Post's E-Rial prepaid account (on the market since 1 September 2002) for bills, online shopping and transfers; Rial Mobile (Yemen Mobile with CAC Bank) only in trial, without the central bank's licence (عدم إصدار البنك المركزي اليمني للتراخيص اللازمة للخدمة هو السبب الوحيد في عدم إطلاقها)
note: The source says it of Yemen as a whole (منحنى التطبيق الفاعل في اليمن).

condition: Who must license electronic payment services
state: The central bank: a service needs its licence to launch, and ministries and government bodies may license e-payment services only after its technical permit (إلاّ بعد الحصول على التصاريح الفنية من قبل البنك المركزي اليمني)

condition: Which electronic money services are available to pay with
state: MB wallet (محفظة “إم بي”), launched on 24 November 2024 by the Yemeni Integrated Company for Electronic Financial Services, for government bodies, companies, business people and the public, linked to banks, ATMs and transfer networks
note: Launched in Sana'a (line 55: الشركة اليمنية المتكاملة للخدمات المالية بصنعاء), with the heads of the Sana'a government's bodies present; the source doesn't say where the wallet can be used.

condition: Whether Starlink equipment may be sold, held or used
state: No: the terminals are banned; holders hand them in by 1 May 2025, after which selling, trading, using, operating, installing or holding them brings seizure, penalties and fines (كون هذه الطرفيات والتجهيزات محظورة)
note: Statement of the Ministry of Telecommunications and Information Technology in the Sana'a government.

condition: Whether Starlink equipment may be sold, held or used
state: No: a merchant who acquires it faces jail, confiscation and removal from the commercial register (الحبس والمصادرة والشطب من السجل التجاري)
note: The ministry's earlier SMS warning, in March (في وقت سابق من مارس الماضي).

condition: Whether Starlink equipment may be sold, held or used
state: Starlink service is sold, at prices that drew public anger and accusations of levying against the telecom provider (أسعار “ستارلينك” تثير السخط الشعبي)
note: A headline in the page's related-articles block (line 75), with no date.

condition: Whether interest-bearing (usurious) transactions are allowed
state: A bill to ban them passed in final form by the House of Representatives (مشروع قانون منع المعاملات الربوية)
place: House of Representatives in Sana'a's area (مجلس النواب بصنعاء)
note: The source reports the bill's passage by the House, not its promulgation.

condition: What financial institutions and designated non-financial businesses must do when serving customers
state: Classify customers and services by money-laundering and terrorist-financing risk, take special care with high risk, and examine large and complex transactions and keep their records at least five years (تصنيف عملائها وخدماتها بحسب درجة مخاطر غسل الأموال وتمويل الإرهاب)
note: Law 17 of 2013 amending law 1 of 2010 on money laundering, art. 10; a law of the Republic of Yemen (الجمهورية: الجمهورية اليمنية), in force from issue.

condition: What financial institutions and designated non-financial businesses must do with a suspicious transaction
state: Report it to the Financial Information Unit at once, whether completed or not (أن تبلغ الوحدة فوراً عن هذه العمليات سواءً تمت أم لم تتم)
note: Law 17 of 2013, art. 13.

condition: What financial institutions, businesses and persons must do with funds of persons listed for freezing
state: Freeze them at once without prior notice, and report the frozen funds to the Unit (تجميد تلك الأموال أو الأصول أو الممتلكات الأخرى فوراً وبدون إشعار مسبق)
note: Law 17 of 2013, art. 17(c), for persons listed under UN Security Council resolution 1267; art. 17 bis(c) (line 480) says the same for nationally listed persons.

condition: Which goods are boycotted from trade
state: Some goods, under the Prime Minister's decision 10 on the boycott, listed as in force (قرار رئيس مجلس الوزراء رقم 10 بشان مقاطعة بعض السلع) (ساري)
note: The Ministry of Economy, Industry and Investment's archive of legislation, with each item's status (حالة النفاذ); the decision's year is given as 2022. The decision itself (item 051) is a scan with no text layer.

condition: Who may trade from a shop
state: Only a person entered in the commercial register of the shop's area (يحظر مزاولة التجارة في محل تجاري إال لمن يكون إسمه مقيداً في السجل التجاري الذي يقع المحل التجاري في دائرته)
note: Commercial register law, decree-law 33 of 1991 as amended, art. 11(1); a law of the Republic of Yemen (art. 11(2): الجمهورية اليمنية). The text gives no dates for its amendments.

condition: Whether a merchant needs a fixed place of business
state: Yes: a fixed place in the Republic of Yemen where he works, unless covered by a commercial registration system the Minister issues by decision (ما لم يكن له محل ثابت في الجمهورية اليمنية يباشر فيه مهنته أو كان مشموالً بنظام التسجيل التجاري الذي يصدر بقرار من الوزير)
note: Commercial register law 33 of 1991 as amended, art. 11(2).

condition: Which merchants are exempt from the commercial register law
state: Small merchants that the regulation defines, exempted by the Minister (يعفي الوزير صغار التجار الذين تحددهم الالئحة)
note: Commercial register law 33 of 1991 as amended, art. 11(3).

condition: When an individual merchant must apply for entry in the commercial register
state: Within sixty days of starting to trade or opening the shop, branch or agency (سـتين يلمـاً مـن تاريخ مزاللة النشال التجاري, i.e. ستين يوماً من تاريخ مزاولة النشاط التجاري)
note: Commercial register law 33 of 1991 as amended, art. 3(1). The PDF's text layer renders some letters wrongly in these articles (e.g. ل for و, ط for ب, د for ق); the quotes are as in the file.

condition: How long an entry in the commercial register lasts
state: Five years, renewed for a fee the Prime Minister sets; renewal is due before expiry and accepted within the following year with a 25% fine (ليجدد ةل مس طناش سنلا طرسم لالد, i.e. ويجدد كل خمس سنوات برسم واحد)
note: Commercial register law 33 of 1991 as amended, art. 5; in this file the word طناش (بناءً, from a later phrase) falls inside the phrase on five years. Letters rendered as in the file.

condition: What a merchant must show on business correspondence and on the shop front
state: Its commercial register number and trade name, matching the register (ردم السجل التجـاري ال ـاب طـ لاسـم التجـاري, i.e. رقم السجل التجاري الخاص به واسمه التجاري)
note: Commercial register law 33 of 1991 as amended, art. 7. Letters rendered as in the file.

condition: Whether consumer-protection rules cover online sales
state: Yes: all transactions and contracts for goods and services offered by traditional or modern means, e-commerce and the internet included; not transactions between suppliers (بما في ذلك التجارة الإلكترونية)
note: Consumer protection law 46 of 2008, art. 4; a law of the Republic of Yemen, issued 7 September 2008 and in force 30 days later (art. 47). Item 040 lists it as in force on 2026-10-10.

condition: What a seller must put on the label of goods offered for sale
state: A clear, fixed Arabic label giving the kind and contents, name, country of origin, exporting country, producer or importer with trade name and address, production or packing date and shelf life, net weight (بطاقة باللغة العربية واضحة ومقروءة)
note: Consumer protection law 46 of 2008, art. 6(a).

condition: In what language a seller must give product and service details
state: Arabic, clearly; a foreign language may be added alongside (بلغة أجنبية إلى جانب اللغة العربية)
note: Consumer protection law 46 of 2008, art. 6(a)-(c); for services, their details and prices.

condition: What a seller must put on documents it issues to consumers, electronic ones included
state: Data identifying it, in particular its register entry, its activity and its trademark (بيانات قيده في السجل بنشاطه وعلامته التجارية)
note: Consumer protection law 46 of 2008, art. 7.

condition: How a seller must show prices
state: Written clearly on the goods, or displayed prominently where the goods or service are offered (كتابة السعر على السلعة وبشكل ظاهر وواضح)
note: Consumer protection law 46 of 2008, art. 8(1).

condition: Whether a seller may refuse a sale, impose quantities or tied purchases, or charge above the advertised price
state: No (عدم الإمتناع عن بيع أي سلعة)
note: Consumer protection law 46 of 2008, art. 8(2); also bars hiding goods to control the market price.

condition: Whether a seller must give the buyer an invoice
state: Yes, on the buyer's request and at no extra charge, showing the seller and shop name, date, price, kind of goods or service, whether used, quantity and delivery date (يلتزم المزود بمنح المستهلك بناء على طلبه فاتورة)
note: Consumer protection law 46 of 2008, art. 9; in the file the words of the opening sentence are out of order (lines 315-316).

condition: What a seller must disclose before an instalment sale
state: Who provides the credit, cash price, total cost, number and value of instalments, period, any down payment, penalties for late or missed payment, and ownership rights during the period (البيع بالتقسيط)
note: Consumer protection law 46 of 2008, art. 11.

condition: What warranty a seller owes on goods and services
state: Quality and hidden defects; after-sales service, spare parts and maintenance for durable goods for at least five years or a period suited to the goods; a no-warranty clause is void except for used goods (كل شرط تعاقدي يقضي بعدم الضمان عدا السلع المستخدمة)
note: Consumer protection law 46 of 2008, art. 14.

condition: Whether a buyer may return or exchange defective goods
state: Yes, refund or exchange if a defect appears within ten days of purchase, with proof of purchase from that seller, unless the goods are quickly perishable or the defect comes from misuse (خلال عشرة أيام من تاريخ شراءها)
note: Consumer protection law 46 of 2008, art. 15.

condition: What a seller of goods sold by weight or measure must have where it sells
state: An approved scale, measure or measuring tool, for use in the sale (بتوفير ميزان أو مكيال أو أداة القياس المعتمدة)
note: Consumer protection law 46 of 2008, art. 16.

condition: Whether counterfeit goods, or goods not conforming to standards or to the agreement, may be sold
state: No (بيع سلعة غير مطابقة للمواصفات)
note: Consumer protection law 46 of 2008, art. 17; it also bars hiding goods' true nature.

condition: Whether a seller may announce discounts, prizes or gifts
state: Only under the rules and procedures the competent bodies set (إلا وفقاً للقواعد والإجراءات التي تحددها الجهات المختصة)
note: Consumer protection law 46 of 2008, art. 18.

condition: What a seller may advertise
state: Nothing misleading or deceptive, and no advertising of a banned or unlicensed activity or of banned goods or goods of unknown origin (لسلعة أو خدمة محظورة أو مجهولة المصدر)
note: Consumer protection law 46 of 2008, arts. 19-20.

condition: Whether unfair terms in a consumer contract bind the consumer
state: No: void if they unbalance the parties' rights against the consumer or exempt the supplier from its legal obligations (كل شرط تعسفي)
note: Consumer protection law 46 of 2008, art. 38.

condition: Whether prices of consumer goods may be capped
state: Yes: after an unjustified rise, the Minister with the Cabinet's approval may cap prices of basic goods exempt from taxes and customs and set profit margins (تحديد السقوف العليا لأسعار السلع الأساسية)
note: Consumer protection law 46 of 2008, art. 41.

condition: What a seller must put on documents it issues to consumers, electronic ones included
state: Its name, address and phone numbers, with a chosen address in the Republic if foreign; for a company, its legal name and head-office and branch addresses; its commercial register number; and any trademark (رقم السجل التجاري للمزود)
note: Executive regulation of consumer protection law 46 of 2008, art. 3. The regulation's own dates are illegible in this text layer (لسنة 2202م; بتارٌخ 0640 / /ه); the ministry's listing (item 040, line 103) gives it the year 2010 and lists it as in force. In force from issue (art. 39).

condition: Whether a seller must give the buyer an invoice
state: Yes, on request and at no extra charge, also showing the warranty period, any free maintenance, use and safety instructions, and the delivery date and method (المزود بأن ٌقدم إلى المستهلك فاتورة بناء على طلبه)
note: Executive regulation of law 46 of 2008, art. 4. The text layer renders ي as ٌ and غ as ؼ; quotes are as in the file.

condition: What a seller must disclose before an instalment sale
state: On the invoice: the total instalment amount, the credit provider, cash price, total cost, number and value of instalments, period, any down payment, penalties for late payment, and ownership rights (فً حال البٌع بالتقسٌط ٌجب أن تتضمن الفاتورة البٌانات اإلضافٌة)
note: Executive regulation of law 46 of 2008, art. 5.

condition: Whether a seller must take and settle consumer complaints
state: Yes: receive, log and settle them, and report to the main supplier if a complaint recurs more than three times (قوم المزود بتلقً وقٌد شكاوي المستهلكٌن وتسوٌتها)
note: Executive regulation of law 46 of 2008, art. 6.

condition: What a seller must do on finding a harmful defect in goods it sells
state: Within five days: report it, warn consumers (two daily papers within 24 hours, the ministry's website, broadcast media, shop fronts), withdraw the goods, take back those sold and refund, or replace at its cost (خلال مدة ال تتجاوز خمسة أٌام)
note: Executive regulation of law 46 of 2008, art. 7.

condition: What warranty a seller owes on goods and services
state: Durable goods: the period in the contract or invoice, or five years if none is set; a defect reported within ten days of its discovery must be repaired or the item replaced within five days, at the seller's cost (وعند عدم تحدٌد مدة الضمان تكون المدة خمس سنوات)
note: Executive regulation of law 46 of 2008, art. 11; it also lists original spare parts, authorised maintenance, manuals and free maintenance.

condition: Whether a buyer may return or exchange defective goods
state: Yes: repair, replacement or refund if a defect appears within the warranty period, with proof of purchase from that seller; not for perishables such as vegetables, fruit and fresh meat, misuse, or a defect the buyer accepted (لتزم المزود برد قٌمة السلعة أو استبدالها أو إصالحها)
note: Executive regulation of law 46 of 2008, art. 14.

condition: In what currency a seller may require a consumer to pay
state: Not in a non-local currency: a seller may not oblige a consumer to buy in one (إلزامه بالشراء بعملة ؼٌر محلٌه)
note: Executive regulation of law 46 of 2008, art. 17 (numbered 12 in the file).

condition: Whether a seller may refuse a sale, impose quantities or tied purchases, or charge above the advertised price
state: No: a seller may not require other purchases, or raise the price for scarcity or the buyer's need (ال ٌجوز للمزود أن ٌشترط على المستهلك شراء سلع معٌنه أو رفع قٌمة السلعة بسبب ندرتها)
note: Executive regulation of law 46 of 2008, art. 17.

condition: Whether unfair terms in a consumer contract bind the consumer
state: No: void, among them excluding the seller's liability, refusing exchange, barring a trial, refusing an invoice, hiding the price, or letting the seller change price or delivery alone (وٌقع باطال كل شرط تعسفً)
note: Executive regulation of law 46 of 2008, art. 17.

condition: Whether sellers may fix prices, divide markets or sell below cost to monopolise
state: No: monopoly in all its forms is banned (حظر االحتكار بكافة أشكاله)
note: Executive regulation of law 46 of 2008, art. 18.

condition: Whether prices of consumer goods may be capped
state: Yes: after an unjustified rise (among the cases, prices not following a rise of the local currency, or exploiting disasters or wars) the Minister with Cabinet approval may set price ceilings and a profit margin per good (بتحدٌد السقوؾ العلٌا ألسعار السلع)
note: Executive regulation of law 46 of 2008, arts. 35-36.

condition: Who may act as a commercial agent of a foreign company
state: A Yemeni national permanently resident in Yemen, with a commercial register of the right category and a registered shop where the agency works; a company only if founded under Yemeni law, based in Yemen, with agency work among its objects and all its capital Yemeni-owned (متمتعا ً بالجنسية اليمنية)
note: Law 23 of 1997 on agencies and branches of foreign companies, arts. 3-4; issued 6 April 1997, in force from issue (art. 56). The PDF's text layer swaps letters (e.g. ظ for ت, ا for ق, ( for ن, ل for ف, و for لا) and drops ك; quotes are as in the file.

condition: Whether a commercial agency for a foreign company needs a licence
state: Yes, a prior licence from the ministry (إو بعد الحصىول علىى ظاخيص مس و من الوزارة, i.e. إلا بعد الحصول على ترخيص مسبق من الوزارة)
note: Law 23 of 1997, art. 6.

condition: Whether vehicles, machinery and electrical or electronic equipment may be imported without a registered agency
state: No: they and any goods needing maintenance and spare parts may be imported only if they have a registered agency in the Republic (إو إاا وجدع لها و اوع مسجلة لي الجمهورية, i.e. إلا إذا وجدت لها وكالات مسجلة في الجمهورية)
note: Law 23 of 1997, art. 17(a). Art. 17(b) obliges those agents to provide maintenance, spare parts and workshops; a note in the file (line 129, ملاحظة) says that in practice this isn't enforced through inspection.

condition: Whether goods under a registered agency may be imported other than through the agent
state: Only if the ministry is satisfied that the agent refused, without a lawful excuse, a written request to open a letter of credit (رلىض الو يىل مهىا طلىب لىتح اوعتمىاد بخاظمىة دو م ار, i.e. رفض الوكيل كتابياً طلب فتح الاعتماد بخاتمه دون مبرر)
note: Law 23 of 1997, art. 15(b).

condition: In which fields a foreign company may operate through a branch in Yemen
state: Banking; technical and consulting services; contracting and construction; tourism and hotels; industrial, oil and mineral, and agricultural and fishery investment; other fields the Cabinet approves; a branch may not act as agent for other foreign companies (العمل المصالي .2الخدماع الفنية واوستشارية)
note: Law 23 of 1997, arts. 21 and 31; art. 22 also requires a licence by ministerial decision.

condition: Which legal forms a commercial company may take
state: General partnership, limited partnership, joint venture (محاصة), joint-stock company, partnership limited by shares, or limited-liability company; a company in any other form is void and can't be registered (فإن ك شركة ر تتخذ أحااد هااذ األشااكا تعتباار باطلااة)
note: Companies law 22 of 1997 as amended, art. 9; issued 6 April 1997, in force from issue (art. 299). The text layer fills justified lines with runs of ا and writes لا as ر; quotes are as in the file.

condition: Who may be a general partner in a partnership company
state: Only a Yemeni national aged eighteen or over (من يكون غير يمنا الجنسية)
note: Companies law 22 of 1997, art. 28.

condition: How many shareholders and how much capital a joint-stock company needs
state: At least five shareholders; capital at least 50 million rials if offered for public subscription, 15 million if closed (خمسين مليون لاير) (خمسة عشر مليون لاير)
note: Companies law 22 of 1997, arts. 61-62; art. 62 as amended by law 28 of 2004.

condition: What a foreign company's branch or office needs before operating in Yemen
state: A licence and publication in the commercial register; the law on such branches governs them (اا ر بعااد التاارخيص لهااا وشااهرها فااا السج التجاريح)
note: Companies law 22 of 1997, art. 64(2)-(3), for foreign joint-stock companies; it also requires separate accounts and an auditor of Yemeni nationality.

condition: Who must make up the majority of a joint-stock company's board
state: Yemeni nationals domiciled in Yemen; the Cabinet may exempt a company with foreign shareholders, but foreigners' share of the board may not exceed their share of the capital (أغلبياااة أعضااااي مجلاااس اإلدارة مااان المتمتعاااين بجنساااية الجمهورياااة)
note: Companies law 22 of 1997, art. 127.

condition: How many partners a limited-liability company may have
state: Two to thirty (عن شريكين وأن ريزيد على ال ين شريكا, i.e. ولا يزيد على ثلاثين شريكا)
note: Companies law 22 of 1997, art. 242 as amended by law 28 of 2004; art. 243 bars such a company from insurance, savings and banking.

condition: What minimum capital a limited-liability company needs
state: None fixed: capital enough for its purposes, set by the partners in the founding contract (ويحاادد الشااركاي رأسااما الشااركة فااا عقااد تأسيسها)
note: Companies law 22 of 1997, art. 248(a) as amended by law 37 of 2008.

condition: Who licenses a limited-liability company, and how fast
state: The registrar (المراقب), within seven working days of a complete application; with no answer in that time the application counts as accepted (يعتباار الطلااب مقبااور)
note: Companies law 22 of 1997, art. 245(a) and (f) as amended by law 24 of 2009.

condition: Whether prices of consumer goods may be capped
state: Prices are set by the market and free competition; the Prime Minister, after Cabinet approval, may cap prices of basic goods (wheat, flour, rice, sugar, medicines, milk, petroleum products) in disasters and emergencies (تحديد السقوف العليا لأسعار السلع الأساسية في حالات الكوارث والطوارئ)
note: Internal trade law 5 of 2007, art. 2 (definitions) and art. 25; issued 28 March 2007 and in force 30 days after publication in the Official Gazette, whose date the text doesn't give. Item 040 lists it as in force on 2026-10-10.

condition: How a seller must show prices
state: Publicly, by any means of advertising, so the buyer can know the price (القيام بإشهار أسعار البضائع أمام المستهلك)
note: Internal trade law 5 of 2007, art. 6, for all merchants.

condition: Whether importers, wholesalers, manufacturers and producers must invoice every sale
state: Yes; refusing to issue sales invoices is fined 20,000 to 100,000 rials (بمنح فواتير لكل عمليات البيع)
note: Internal trade law 5 of 2007, arts. 7 and 16.

condition: Whether sellers may fix prices, divide markets or sell below cost to monopolise
state: No: merchants must keep to free competition and avoid monopoly; hiding basic goods to monopolise them brings at least a year in jail (والابتعاد عن الاحتكار)
note: Internal trade law 5 of 2007, arts. 5 and 14.

condition: Whether spoiled, damaged or expired goods may be sold
state: No: offering them for sale brings up to six months' jail or a fine up to 500,000 rials, and selling them six months' jail with damages; the goods are destroyed at the seller's cost (كل من عرض بغرض البيع بضائع فاسدة أو تالفة)
note: Internal trade law 5 of 2007, art. 13.

condition: Whether prohibited or smuggled goods may be sold
state: No: entering or trading prohibited goods (those barred by Islamic law or the laws in force) brings one to five years' jail and confiscation; offering or selling smuggled goods is punished under the customs law (بالحبس مدة لا تقل عن سنة ولا تزيد على خمس سنوات وبمصادرة تلك السلع)
note: Internal trade law 5 of 2007, art. 2 (definition of prohibited goods), arts. 19-20.

condition: Whether goods may move freely between governorates
state: Yes: no governmental or other body may block their movement between administrative units, unless a competent body proves they could spread epidemics (منع إنتقال البضائع بين مختلف الوحدات الإدارية بالجمهورية إلا إذا ثبت)
note: Internal trade law 5 of 2007, art. 22; art. 17 punishes an official who blocks goods by abusing his post.

condition: Which goods are boycotted from trade
state: American goods and brands: their entry and trading are banned under decision 10 of 1446, with a set period to clear existing stock; the lists of American brands are being updated (منع دخول أو تداول السلع والبضائع الأمريكية)
note: Boycott committee of the Ministry of Economy, Industry and Investment in the Sana'a government; importers whose goods were held at ports pledge not to import again.

condition: Which goods are boycotted from trade
state: American products: three months from 23 April, after which no American product may enter or be in any shop (منع دخول أي سلعة أو قطعة من أي منتج أمريكي ومنع تواجدها في أي محل تجاري)
place: Supreme Political Council in Sana'a's area (المجلس السياسي الأعلى في صنعاء)
note: Directive of the head of the Supreme Political Council on 23 April (2025, as the source's 'last April'); held_at is the end of the source's three months.

condition: What an individual needs to enter the commercial register
state: For Yemeni individuals and bodies: attend the office in person or by official proxy, with an ID card copy, a trade-name reservation, and a lease certified by the neighbourhood head (عاقل الحي) or other certified proof of premises; for money exchange, the central bank's preliminary approval; done in three days (عقد ايجار معمد من العاقل)
place: Ministry of Economy, Industry and Investment's area (وزارة الاقتصاد والصناعة والاستثمار)
note: The ministry's service page, last edited 12 June 2026 (line 111); the ministry's address is Sana'a (line 127).

condition: Whether a merchant can apply online for the ministry's registrations
state: Yes, through the ministry's e-portal (e-moit.gov.ye) (عن بُعد عبر بوابتها الإلكترونية)
place: Ministry of Economy, Industry and Investment's area (وزارة الاقتصاد والصناعة والاستثمار)

condition: Whether government taxes and fees can be paid electronically
state: Yes, by Mobile Money wallet (طريقة الدفع: محفظة موبايل موني)
place: Ministry of Economy, Industry and Investment's area (وزارة الاقتصاد والصناعة والاستثمار)
note: The service: individuals' commercial register (item 053). The page leaves the fee itself blank (الرسوم:).

condition: What an individual trading establishment (import, wholesale, retail, services, export, contracting) needs to enter the commercial register
state: Proof of owned premises or a certified lease, ID card, four photos, the signed form, the trade-name reservation, and documents in Arabic or with certified translation; done in three days split between the ministry and its office (صورة وثيقة اثبات ملكية العقار المزاول فيه النشاط او عقد ايجار معمد)
place: Ministry of Economy, Industry and Investment's area (وزارة الاقتصاد والصناعة والاستثمار)
note: The ministry's service page for individual establishments by category (item 054).

condition: Whether a foreigner may enter the commercial register as an individual merchant
state: Yes, giving a residence permit and a work permit from the competent body (صورة الإقامة للتاجر الأجنبي مع تصريح مزاولة العمل)
place: Ministry of Economy, Industry and Investment's area (وزارة الاقتصاد والصناعة والاستثمار)
note: Listed among the documents for individual trading establishments; the page for individuals in general (item 053) names its target group as Yemenis (يمنيين).

condition: When an individual merchant must apply for entry in the commercial register
state: Within sixty days of starting to trade or opening the shop (خلال ستين يوما من تاريخ مزاولة النشاط التجاري او افتتاح المحل)
place: Ministry of Economy, Industry and Investment's area (وزارة الاقتصاد والصناعة والاستثمار)

condition: Whether a merchant can apply online for the ministry's registrations
state: Yes, through the ministry's e-portal (e-moit.gov.ye) (عن بُعد عبر بوابتها الإلكترونية)
place: Ministry of Economy, Industry and Investment's area (وزارة الاقتصاد والصناعة والاستثمار)
note: This page adds that documents are in Arabic or with a certified translation (line 73).

condition: Whether government taxes and fees can be paid electronically
state: Yes, by Mobile Money wallet (طريقة الدفع: محفظة موبايل موني)
place: Ministry of Economy, Industry and Investment's area (وزارة الاقتصاد والصناعة والاستثمار)
note: The service: commercial register for individual establishments (item 054).

condition: When a company must apply for entry in the commercial register
state: Within sixty days of starting its activity (سـتين يلمـا مـن تـاريخ مزاللـة نشـاللا, i.e. ستين يوما من تاريخ مزاولة نشاطها)
note: Commercial register law 33 of 1991 as amended, art. 3(2), for companies based in the Republic; letters rendered as in the file.

condition: When a foreign company's branch or agency must apply for entry in the commercial register
state: Within sixty days of starting its activity (سـتين يلمـا مـن تــاريخ مزاللـــ نشــال اللةالــة, i.e. ستين يوما من تاريخ مزاولة نشاط الوكالة)
note: Commercial register law 33 of 1991 as amended, art. 3(4); letters rendered as in the file.

condition: When a company must apply for entry in the commercial register
state: Within thirty days of its founding or licensing (خلال ثلاثين يوما من تاريخ انشائها او الترخيص لها)
place: Ministry of Economy, Industry and Investment's area (وزارة الاقتصاد والصناعة والاستثمار)
note: The ministry's service page for companies (item 055); the commercial register law (item 041, art. 3(2)) gives sixty days (YQ-B132).

condition: Whether a merchant needs a fixed place of business
state: Yes: no one may work as importer, exporter, contractor, broker or commission agent without a fixed place in the Republic where he works (اذا لم يكن له محل ثابت في الجمهورية يباشر فيه مهنته)
place: Ministry of Economy, Industry and Investment's area (وزارة الاقتصاد والصناعة والاستثمار)

condition: Who may found a commercial company, and how many founders it needs
state: At least five partners, each aged eighteen or over (a minor's share through a guardian), none a government employee or chartered accountant; shares of at least 10,000 rials; for capital companies, a bank certificate of the capital deposit (ان لا يقل عدد الشركاء عن خمسه اشخاص)
place: Ministry of Economy, Industry and Investment's area (وزارة الاقتصاد والصناعة والاستثمار)
note: As listed on the page for registering commercial companies, without naming the company type; the companies law sets five only for joint-stock companies and two to thirty for limited-liability ones (YQ-B109, YQ-B112).

condition: How long a trade-name reservation lasts
state: Up to sixty days, after which the request is cancelled (فترة الحجز لا تتجاوز 60 يوماً مالم سيتم الغاء الطلب)
place: Ministry of Economy, Industry and Investment's area (وزارة الاقتصاد والصناعة والاستثمار)
note: Stated in the description of the companies' registration service (line 50).

condition: Whether a merchant can apply online for the ministry's registrations
state: Yes, through the ministry's e-portal (e-moit.gov.ye) (عن بُعد عبر بوابتها الإلكترونية)
place: Ministry of Economy, Industry and Investment's area (وزارة الاقتصاد والصناعة والاستثمار)
note: This page says the service is done within an hour (line 55).

condition: Whether government taxes and fees can be paid electronically
state: Yes, by Mobile Money wallet (طريقة الدفع: محفظة موبايل موني)
place: Ministry of Economy, Industry and Investment's area (وزارة الاقتصاد والصناعة والاستثمار)
note: The service: commercial register for companies (item 055).

condition: Whether a commercial-registration applicant must attend in person
state: Yes, in person or by official proxy
place: Ministry of Economy, Industry and Investment's area (وزارة الاقتصاد والصناعة والاستثمار)
note: Item 053: حضور العميل شخصيا الى المكتب المختص او عمل وكالة رسمية لشخص اخر.

condition: Whether a commercial-registration applicant must attend in person
state: Yes, in person or by official proxy
place: Ministry of Economy, Industry and Investment's area (وزارة الاقتصاد والصناعة والاستثمار)
note: Item 054: ان يتقدم التاجر بنفسة او عبر وكيل بوكالة رسمية.

condition: Who may act as a commercial agent of a foreign company
state: A Yemeni national permanently resident in Yemen, appointed directly by the manufacturer, with a commercial register of the matching category and a registered shop in the agency's area; a company only if founded under Yemeni law, based in Yemen, with agency work among its objects and all its capital Yemeni-owned (أن يكون الوكيل متمتعاً بالجنسية اليمنية ومقيماً بصفة دائمة في اليمن)
place: Ministry of Economy, Industry and Investment's area (وزارة الاقتصاد والصناعة والاستثمار)
note: The ministry's service page for registering a commercial agency (item 056).

condition: What registering a commercial agency for a foreign company requires
state: An agency for unused goods, the contract certified by the principal's chamber of commerce and foreign ministry, the Yemeni embassy and Yemen's foreign ministry, the agent's valid commercial register and tax card, the principal's quality certificate, and an undertaking to supply spare parts and maintenance; five working days (يجب أن تكون السلعة موضوع الوكالة ( غير مستخدمة ))
place: Ministry of Economy, Industry and Investment's area (وزارة الاقتصاد والصناعة والاستثمار)

condition: Whether a merchant can apply online for the ministry's registrations
state: Yes, through the ministry's e-portal (e-moit.gov.ye) (عن بُعد عبر بوابتها الإلكترونية)
place: Ministry of Economy, Industry and Investment's area (وزارة الاقتصاد والصناعة والاستثمار)
note: The service: registering a commercial agency (item 056).

condition: Whether government taxes and fees can be paid electronically
state: Yes, by Mobile Money wallet (طريقة الدفع: محفظة موبايل موني)
place: Ministry of Economy, Industry and Investment's area (وزارة الاقتصاد والصناعة والاستثمار)
note: The service: registering a commercial agency (item 056).

condition: What form a commercial register takes
state: Electronic only: paper registers cancelled (إلغاء العمل بالسجلات التجارية الورقية، وحصر التعامل بالسجلات التجارية الإلكترونية)
place: Ministry of Industry and Trade in Sana'a's area (وزارة الصناعة والتجارة في صنعاء)

condition: Whether a merchant can apply online for the ministry's registrations
state: Yes, through the ministry's e-portal, in official use since the October before (دشنت مطلع أكتوبر الماضي، العمل رسميا بالبوابة الإلكترونية لإنجاز المعاملات عن بعد)
place: Ministry of Industry and Trade in Sana'a's area (وزارة الصناعة والتجارة في صنعاء)

condition: Whether a merchant can apply online for the ministry's registrations
state: Yes: all 76 of the ministry's services are offered through its e-portal, among them changes to commercial registers, companies and agencies, and foreign-branch registration (أصبحت جميع خدماتها البالغة 76 خدمة “مقدمة إلكترونياً”)
place: Ministry of Economy, Industry and Investment's area (وزارة الاقتصاد والصناعة والاستثمار)
note: The source names the ministry as that of the Sana'a government (بحكومة صنعاء).

condition: Whether a commercial agency struck off for non-renewal can be restored
state: Yes, within a last exceptional 90 days, by applying through the ministry's e-portal (فرصة استثنائية أخيرة لمدة 90 يوماً لتصحيح أوضاع الوكالات التجارية المشطوبة بسبب عدم التجديد)
place: Ministry of Economy in Sana'a's area (صنعاء: وزارة الاقتصاد)
note: A one-line news item; the source doesn't say when the 90 days start.

condition: Whether depositors can draw their bank deposits
state: Small depositors (20 million rials or less) are being repaid under the exceptional-mechanism law: 180,000 had received their deposits from the banks by the end of July, the first time in ten years (لأول مرة منذ عشر سنوات مضت)
place: Government of Change and Building's area (حكومة التغيير والبناء)
note: Ministry of Finance, as reported in the government's one-year report (Saba, carried by 26sep.net, dated 12 August 2025).

condition: Which goods may be imported
state: Not some goods with a local equivalent that covers the whole market (joint economy and finance decision to protect local production); and of 86 agricultural products, some stopped entirely and some reduced (الحظر والمنع النهائي لاستيراد بعض السلع والبضائع التي يوجد لها مثيل محلي)
place: Government of Change and Building's area (حكومة التغيير والبناء)

condition: What fees small producers and productive families pay
state: None: exempt from any fees under the 2025 investment law (اعفاء صغار المنتجين والاسر المنتجة من أي رسوم)
place: Government of Change and Building's area (حكومة التغيير والبناء)

condition: Whether a merchant can apply online for the ministry's registrations
state: Yes: all 72 of the ministry's services are offered through its e-portal (باتت جميع خدمات الوزارة البالغة 72 خدمة تقدم عبر البوابة الإلكترونية)
place: Ministry of Economy, Industry and Investment's area (وزارة الاقتصاد والصناعة والاستثمار)
note: Item 059 (12 April 2025) gives the number as 76.

condition: Whether government taxes and fees can be paid electronically
state: Yes, and spreading: electronic collection for most public revenues, the e-Sadad platform, traffic fees through the post's digital payments platform, and land-transport fees electronically or by phone (نشر أنظمة التحصيل الإلكتروني لمعظم الموارد العامة)
place: Government of Change and Building's area (حكومة التغيير والبناء)

condition: Which electronic money services are available to pay with
state: Yemen Wallet (المحفظة الإلكترونية يمن والت), being rolled out by the telecom ministry, alongside the post's network of financial-services agents
place: Government of Change and Building's area (حكومة التغيير والبناء)

condition: Whether delivery services through e-platforms are regulated
state: Yes: the telecom ministry has organised them (تنظيم خدمات التوصيل عبر المنصات الإلكترونية)
place: Government of Change and Building's area (حكومة التغيير والبناء)
note: Listed among the telecom ministry's achievements, without details.

condition: Whether interest-bearing (usurious) transactions are allowed
state: A law bans them, and the finance ministry is completing the steps to apply it (استكمال الخطوات والإجراءات المتعلقة بقانون منع المعاملات الربوية)
place: Government of Change and Building's area (حكومة التغيير والبناء)

condition: Whether pharmacies and private facilities may sell tuberculosis drugs
state: No: dispensing is limited to the national tuberculosis programme (بمنع بيع أو صرف أدوية السل في الصيدليات والمنشآت الخاصة)
place: Government of Change and Building's area (حكومة التغيير والبناء)
note: Decision of the Ministry of Health and Environment.

condition: How available cash banknotes are
state: Short: a liquidity crisis in the national currency, which the finance ministry says it has taken measures to overcome (أزمة السيولة من العملة الوطنية)
place: Government of Change and Building's area (حكومة التغيير والبناء)

condition: What fees small producers and productive families pay
state: None: the new investment law exempts small and micro enterprises, entrepreneurs, innovators, and the economic-empowerment projects of agricultural associations and productive families from all government fees (من جميع الرسوم الحكومية)
note: As stated by the Minister of Economy, Industry and Investment.

condition: What registering a trade name or trademark costs a productive family
state: Nothing: free through the ministry's e-portal (عبر البوابة الإلكترونية للوزارة مجاناً)
place: Ministry of Economy, Industry and Investment's area (وزارة الاقتصاد والصناعة والاستثمار)

condition: What fees small producers and productive families pay
state: None: small and micro projects (productive or service, investment up to US$100,000 or its rial equivalent, wholly Yemeni-owned) are exempt from government fees (بإعفاء المشاريع الصغيرة والأصغر (الإنتاجية والخدمية) من الرسوم الحكومية)
place: Prime Minister in Sana'a's area (رئيس مجلس الوزراء بصنعاء)
note: Prime Minister's circular under investment law 3 of 1446/2025, published by the General Authority for Small and Micro Enterprises in Sana'a.

condition: How quickly a small project's permit application must be decided
state: Within three days at most (سقف زمني لا يتجاوز ثلاثة أيام للبتّ في طلبات التصاريح)
place: Prime Minister in Sana'a's area (رئيس مجلس الوزراء بصنعاء)

condition: On what value sales tax is charged
state: The real, fixed value on the sales invoice, i.e. the actual selling price; for sales through intermediaries or related persons, not less than the wholesale market price (القيمة الحقيقية الثابتة لفاتورة البي)
note: General sales tax law 19 of 2001 as amended by law 42 of 2005, art. 8 (line 77 says the text merges both laws). Most of this PDF's text layer is in a shifted encoding or blank; arts. 8-12 are legible, with some letters replaced (e.g. ر for doubled letters); quotes are as in the file.

condition: What invoice a seller registered for sales tax must issue
state: A single sales invoice for each sale of taxable goods or services; to another registered person, an original and a copy, the copy kept by the seller; the invoice's contents are set by decision of the head of the Tax Authority (فراتورة بير واحردة عرن كر عمليرة بير)
note: General sales tax law, art. 11.

condition: What records a seller registered for sales tax must keep
state: Regular accounting books and records, entered as transactions happen; if kept on computer, the systems and books must be in Yemen for the Tax Authority to inspect (والدفاتر موجودة في اليمن)
note: General sales tax law, art. 12.

condition: What a seller needs to bid in government tenders and auctions
state: A sales-tax registration certificate (تقديم شهادات التسجيل كشرط للدخول في المناقصات والمزايدات بالجهات الحكومية)
note: Title of the Finance Minister's decision 21 of 2007, as listed on the Tax Authority's sales-tax page (live, captured 2026-10-10); the decision's text isn't in the run.

condition: Whether taxpayers can use the Tax Authority's services electronically
state: Yes: it offers an e-services app, and links the Mobile Money app (تطبيق الخدمات الإلكترونية) (تطبيق موبايل موني)
note: The page doesn't say what the Mobile Money app is used for.

condition: Who must register for general sales tax, and when
state: Anyone whose annual taxable sales reach 50 million rials, selling directly or through an intermediary, and every importer of taxable goods or services whatever the amount; apply within the first 15 days of the month the threshold is reached; voluntary registration below it is allowed; done in one working day without fee (حد التسجيل عن ( )50,000,000خمسني مليو ريال)
note: The Tax Authority's registration guide, dated December 2022 (Jumada I 1444) on its cover, citing sales tax law 19 of 2001, arts. 6-7. The text layer replaces some letters (e.g. ة for ك, ا for ع); quotes are as in the file.

condition: Whether a business needs a tax card to contract, trade or renew licences
